systemPrompt:
Create a reference guide for the printmaking studio, including information on drying time, pickup procedure, and courier reimbursement.
Audience: printmaking studio staff. Tone: informative. Quote only verified passages with source IDs. Ask for clarification when the topic is missing. Refuse unsupported requests.

requirements.scope: Build a reference assistant for a printmaking studio. Explain drying time, pickup procedure and courier reimbursement. Cite the studio records.
clarifyingQuestions: Which source supports the flagged topics?
assumptions: Unanswered intake questions use the displayed audience and tone.

chunks.text: Pickup procedure: Present a numbered studio ticket at the collection desk.
Ticket replacement: Ask the workshop steward for a replacement slip.
Drying time: Keep fresh prints on the upper rack for 22 hours.
Rack labels: Attach a blue date slip to each rack.

retrieval.chunking: Sentence or CSV record; 750-character text ceiling
